description_en: Queries the databases, tables, and columns on which a database account has permissions
description_zh: 获取给定账号可见的库表列
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-account-privilege-objects --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1k3wdmt1390000 --account-name test --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccountPrivilegeObjects

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The permission level. Valid values: Database, Table, and Column. Global is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 权限级别，只能传入库（Database)）、表（Table）、列（Column）级别，不能传入全局（Global）级别
parameters.name: privilege_type

parameters.help_en: The database name that is used to filter databases
parameters.help_zh: 根据给定的数据库名称进行筛选
parameters.name: database_privilege_object

parameters.help_en: The table name that is used to filter tables
parameters.help_zh: 根据给定的表名称进行筛选
parameters.name: table_privilege_object

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页含有条目的最大数量，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The column name that is used to filter columns
parameters.help_zh: 根据给定的列名进行筛选
parameters.name: column_privilege_object

items.description_en: The permission objects, including the database, table, and column
items.description_zh: 权限对象，为库、表、列的三元组

Column.description_en: The name of the column. This parameter is returned when PrivilegeType is set to Column
Column.description_zh: 列名称，当权限界别是列时返回该字段

Database.description_en: The name of the database. This parameter is returned when PrivilegeType is set to Database, Table, or Column
Database.description_zh: 数据库名称，当权限级别是库、表、列时返回该字段

Description.description_en: The description that is specified when you create a table or column. This parameter is returned only when PrivilegeType is set to Database or Table, indicating the database description or table description
Description.description_zh: 创建表/列时指定的描述。只有当权限级别为库和表时才有值，分别代表库和表的描述

Table.description_en: The name of the table. This parameter is returned when PrivilegeType is set to Table or Column
Table.description_zh: 表名称，当权限级别是表和列时返回该字段

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 页大小，和传入的值一致

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
